release_notes:
- Faster Library: right after starting Nexus, or after switching project, opening a library no longer makes you wait several seconds. The cause was the citation-mark search in Citations, which prepared every record of every project in the background; it now loads only when you open Citations, and only for the active library.
- Nexus uses less CPU while you are not doing anything (about half as much): the tabs that refresh on their own now pause while they are hidden and catch up as soon as you open them. Clicks are less likely to wait behind background work.
- Watch folders: new PDFs in a watch folder are now attached to their record automatically when the DOI or title match is clear, as the setting intends. Before, most of them stayed in the inbox waiting for you, and each folder was scanned twice.
